_doc: Stratford Squirrel sound effects, made with the ElevenLabs sound-generation API (generate.py). name: sound id; n: takes; dur: requested seconds; level: playback gain (0..1); loop: seamless ambient loop; hold: generated but kept out of web/ and index.json until the owner approves (drop the key and rerun processing to enable); library: true: kept only as an original in game/assets/sfx/library/, never processed or loaded. round: S1-S4 of sound-requests.md. skip: take numbers kept as originals but left out of web/ (clearly broken takes).
style: Natural, close-miked, clean recording, no music, no voices or speech. Autumn in a small Ontario town.
